bullets.title: The Price of Everything
bullets.note: ,** directed by [Nathaniel Kahn](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/8kue0m6zzuohx8x4n/gwfnh5h8l35g0/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaW1kYi5jb20vbmFtZS9ubTA0MzQ4OTYv). I watched this film after both my brother and a close friend raved about it. It is often hilarious, sometimes nauseating, and always entertaining. Here’s the description: “With unprecedented access to pivotal artists and the white-hot market surrounding them, _The Price of Everything_ dives deep into the contemporary art world, holding a mirror up to our values and our times — where everything can be bought and sold.” You can [stream it on HBO](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/8kue0m6zzuohx8x4n/33tphkh527lx8/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaGJvLmNvbS9kb2N1bWVudGFyaWVzL3RoZS1wcmljZS1vZi1ldmVyeXRoaW5n), and there are a few [screenings coming up](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/8kue0m6zzuohx8x4n/4mcvhehdprewo/aHR0cDovL3d3dy50aGVwcmljZW9mZXZlcnl0aGluZy5jb20vc2NyZWVuaW5ncw==) in early 2019 around the U.S. **Personally, I hope to learn much, much more about art and the art world in 2019.** If you might have lessons to share or a lot of experience, please let me know! Just direct a tweet at me ([@tferriss](https://el2.fourhourmail.com/c/8kue0m6zzuohx8x4n/r4s8hohl30r49/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS90ZmVycmlzcw==)) and include #timart so I can find you. Thanks!

bullets.title: Les Doigts de l'Homme - Festival Jazz de Coti Chiavari
bullets.note: I can’t get enough of these guys. I play this particular video in the background as I write. The beginning is a remarkable demonstration of skill, but the “real” music starts around 2:00. If you want a fantastic mood elevator, this might do the trick.
